_comment: Site-wide settings that are safe to commit. Anything secret or machine-specific (port, public origin, Stripe keys) lives in oats.env, never here. Flags: `mode` full|coming_soon, `checkout.mode` preorder|stripe|shopify, `claims_locked` turns numeric nutrition on, `pricing_locked` removes the pre-order pricing note, `reviews_enabled` reserves the review slots until there are real reviews.
subline: Creamy oat pudding. Big flavor. Real ingredients.

stripe._comment: When mode is stripe: set OATS_STRIPE_SECRET in oats.env and fill stripe_price ids per SKU below.

shopify._comment: When mode is shopify: store domain plus a variant id per SKU.
